title: docs(memory): drop stale hindsight-all lazy-install claim
claim: With the current Hindsight catalog pin, local embedded mode does not lazy-install hindsight-all; its in-process packages are the plugin's declared dependencies.

evidence.doc_text_on_main: website/docs/user-guide/features/memory-providers.md:468 — "In local embedded mode the plugin installs `hindsight-all` on first use through Hermes' lazy-install path, which honours `security.allow_lazy_installs`."; zh-Hans memory-providers.md:350 — "本地用 `hindsight-all` ... 需要 `hindsight-client >= 0.4.22`（会话启动时若版本过旧则自动升级）"
evidence.source: plugin-catalog/hindsight.yaml:3 sha eb021da3 (bumped by 5e4857bf2e: 'drops the retired tools.lazy_deps call and the hindsight-all dependency ... local_embedded runs on PM-managed Hermes', known_issues removed). Plugin at that SHA (read-only gh api): pyproject dependencies hindsight-client>=0.10.1,<1 and hindsight-embed>=0.10.1,<1; embedded.py _check_local_runtime() imports only hindsight_client + hindsight_embed.daemon_embed_manager and documents that the server runs out of process. tools/lazy_deps.py on main is an old-updater stub.
evidence.red: Doc names a dependency and install path the pinned plugin no longer has.
evidence.green: Sentence replaced with the pinned plugin's behaviour; zh-Hans install text brought in line. The released v1.2.1 pin proposed upstream (#129093, d56c4ac) declares the same two dependencies in pyproject, so the text survives that bump.
evidence.adjacent: external plugin read at the pinned SHA (gh api, read-only); no in-repo test covers the third-party plugin's install path. docs-site-checks equivalent on the bundle branch: website/scripts/extract-skills.py + generate-skill-docs.py leave website/docs, website/sidebars.ts and website/i18n unchanged (clean); website/scripts/check_doc_links.py OK. added lines scanned for MDX hazards ({ } or raw <tag> outside inline code / fences): none.
